meta.what: Precomputed, conceptual distributions of renewable output for the model on the home page. Outcome and forecast are in per unit of installed capacity: 0 = no output, 1 = full output.
meta.source: Elia Open Data Platform: wind ODS031, solar ODS032. License CC BY 4.0 (attribution: Elia Transmission Belgium SA).

method.conditioning: scripts/lib/conditioning.rb, bin mode (pooled forecast bins, each shifted by its own center, weighted by n; clipped to [0, 1] with atoms at the walls)
method.state_pool: forecast bins with center within +-h of the level; h from 0.03 by 0.01 until n >= 3000 (h <= 0.07)
method.cloud_pool: per forecast bin: the bin, widened by one bin each side until n >= 1000 (at most 3)
method.smoothing: continuous part convolved with a Gaussian kernel reflected at both walls; sigma = 0.9 min(sd, IQR / 1.34) n^(-1/5) of the unsmoothed pool, clamped to [0.01, 0.03] pu (states: field smooth); atoms unchanged

encoding.q: area states: base64 of 1024 little-endian uint16, Q((i + 0.5) / 1024) * 65535
encoding.dens: area states: base64 of 512 little-endian uint16, density of the continuous part on cell [j, j+1)/512, as a fraction of dpeak (per pu) * 65535; integrates to 1 - p0 - p1
encoding.cloud_q: cloud states: base64 of count x 64 little-endian uint16, bin-major; Q_b((j + 0.5) / 64) * 65535, zeros where n[b] = 0
encoding.cloud_q_tail: cloud states: tail_v lists 12 ranks beyond the 64-point table; q_tail is base64 of count x 12 little-endian uint16, bin-major, Q_b(tail_v[j]) * 65535, zeros where n[b] = 0.
encoding.cloud_n: cloud states: quarter-hours per forecast bin (the forecast marginal; uniform inside each bin [lo + b w, lo + (b + 1) w], the last bin ends at last_hi)
